name: Distributed web crawler / Define the success contract

intent.outcome: Design a scalable web crawler that traverses billions of web pages while honoring politeness.
intent.users: Callers, state owners and operators named by the problem.
intent.constraints: Make ordering, durability, capacity and retry assumptions explicit. Synthetic domain counters and duplicate probability; no network scraping, robots.txt parser, DNS cache, real URL fingerprints or production index.
intent.success: An observable request path, bounded waiting, visible failures and a justified recovery policy.

concepts.label: Users and requests
concepts.responsibility: Who issues requests, and which identities or deadlines travel with them?

concepts.label: System responsibility
concepts.responsibility: Design a scalable web crawler that traverses billions of web pages while honoring politeness.
